figurative_meaning_en: a smiling face, often denoting cheerful or brave demeanor even in adversity
similar_in_english: smile in the face of death
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার হাসিমুখ দেখে সবাই মুগ্ধ হয়ে গেল।
কষ্টের মধ্যেও তার হাসিমুখ ফিকে হয়নি।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone was captivated by his smiling face.
Even in hardship, his smiling face didn't fade.
history: References Khudiram Bose, a Bengali revolutionary who smiled on his way to the gallows in 1908, symbolizing fearless patriotism amid British colonial rule.
note: The idiom draws from the famous quote 'হাসি হাসি পরব ফাঁসি দেখবে ভারতবাসী' associated with Khudiram's execution.
